rules.title: Customer policy or benefit statement visible
rules.description: A customer's policy certificate, benefit statement, invoice reimbursement or premium invoice is visible, whether or not identifiers are redacted

detection.signal: OCR finds two or more policy / benefit statement field labels in one frame: Policy Number, Insured Person, Insurance Number, Insurance Model, Deductible, Monthly Premium, Cost Sharing, Date of Treatment, Benefit Statement

rules.basis: Swiss FADP (nFADP/revDSG) — health data is sensitive personal data; ATSG Art. 33 duty of confidentiality
rules.reviewerNote: A visible policy certificate or benefit statement exposes a real insured person's cover, deductible and treatment data even when the name is blacked out. Health insurance data is sensitive personal data under the FADP.
rules.suggestedFix: Remove any real policy certificate, benefit statement or premium invoice. Use an approved Sympany sample document or a fully synthetic mock-up instead.

rules.title: Customer personal data visible in a product context
rules.description: Customer personal data visible (name, AHV number, contact details, face) in a sales or product context

detection.signal: PII pattern match on extracted text (AHV/AVS number, Swiss phone number, e-mail); face detection where a product entity is also present

rules.basis: Swiss FADP (nFADP/revDSG) Art. 6 & 30 — processing principles and consent
rules.reviewerNote: An insured person's name, AHV number, contact details or face shown alongside a Sympany product turns a marketing asset into a disclosure of personal data.
rules.suggestedFix: Remove or fully pseudonymise the customer identifier. Do not rely on partial redaction. Obtain written consent and Sympany Legal sign-off before featuring any identifiable person.

rules.title: Unsubstantiated premium-saving figure quoted
rules.description: A specific premium saving, discount or reduction percentage is quoted without the basis it depends on (region, age group, deductible, insurance model)

detection.signal: Numeric percentage in the same text block as: save, saving, cheaper, discount, rebate, premium reduction, lower premium

rules.basis: UWG/LCD Art. 3 para. 1 lit. b (misleading statements); KVG/LAMal Art. 62 (premium reductions for alternative models)
rules.reviewerNote: Premium savings for the family doctor, Telmed or HMO models and for higher deductibles vary by premium region, age group and model. A blanket percentage presents a best case as typical, which the UWG treats as misleading.
rules.suggestedFix: Remove the saving percentage, or state the exact example it is based on (premium region, age group, deductible, model, year) and refer to the official FOPH premium data.

rules.title: Premiums, cover or acceptance described as guaranteed or free
rules.description: Premiums described as guaranteed or frozen, cover described as free or unlimited, or supplementary insurance acceptance implied to need no health declaration

detection.signal: Fixed lexicon: guaranteed, guarantee, premium freeze, frozen premiums, no premium increase, for free, free of charge, everything covered, no health questions

rules.basis: UWG/LCD Art. 3 para. 1 lit. b; KVG/LAMal Art. 61 & KVAG Art. 16 (premiums are set annually and approved by the FOPH)
rules.reviewerNote: Basic insurance premiums are reset every year and approved by the FOPH, and supplementary insurance is underwritten on a health declaration. Promising a premium freeze, free cover or guaranteed acceptance misleads a reasonable consumer.
rules.suggestedFix: Delete any language promising guaranteed or frozen premiums, free cover or acceptance without a health declaration. Describe the actual premium mechanism and underwriting.

rules.title: Customer testimonial or chat screenshot as proof
rules.description: Customer testimonial, chat screenshot or forwarded customer message used as proof of savings or claim payouts

detection.signal: Messaging-app UI detected (chat bubbles, read receipts, timestamp rail) together with a currency amount or a percentage

rules.basis: UWG/LCD Art. 3 para. 1 lit. b; FADP consent requirements; SLK principles on testimonials
rules.reviewerNote: A customer chat screenshot or testimonial used as proof of savings or payouts cannot be substantiated and usually lacks the customer's documented consent.
rules.suggestedFix: Remove the testimonial, chat screenshot or forwarded customer message, or replace it with an approved testimonial that has documented written consent and no individual figures.

rules.title: Personalised insurance recommendation in public content
rules.description: A personalised recommendation (insurance model, deductible or supplementary product) directed at an individual in public content

detection.signal: Second-person imperative plus a named product. Flags for review only; the information / advice line is a legal judgement the engine will not make

rules.basis: ISA/VAG Art. 45 (intermediary information duties). Advisory until Sympany Legal sets the boundary
rules.reviewerNote: Telling an individual which model, deductible or supplementary product to take may cross from general information into advice that requires a needs analysis. Where that line sits is a legal judgement, so the engine flags but does not block.
rules.suggestedFix: Reframe as general information, or route the individual to a Sympany customer advisor or the mySympany premium calculator for personal advice.

rules.title: Urgency, scarcity or pressure language
rules.description: Urgency, scarcity or pressure language used to drive an insurance switch or purchase

detection.signal: Lexicon: last chance, closing soon, limited slots, act now, offer ends, only X left

rules.basis: UWG/LCD Art. 3 para. 1 lit. h (aggressive sales methods). Advisory: legitimate when referring to the 30 November switching deadline
rules.reviewerNote: Pressure language can be an aggressive sales method, but reminders of the statutory 30 November basic insurance switching deadline are legitimate, so the call is left to a reviewer.
rules.suggestedFix: Remove pressure language tied to a product decision. Time limits are acceptable only for genuine deadlines such as the 30 November switching date or event registration.

rules.title: Direct comparison against a named competitor
rules.description: Direct comparison against a named competitor health insurer, its premiums or its benefits

detection.signal: Competitor entity detected alongside a comparative construction or a figure

rules.basis: UWG/LCD Art. 3 para. 1 lit. e (comparative advertising). Advisory pending Sympany comparative advertising policy
rules.reviewerNote: A premium or benefit comparison against a named insurer must be accurate, like-for-like (same region, age group, deductible and model) and sourced. Whether it is permitted at all depends on Sympany's comparative advertising policy.
rules.suggestedFix: Remove the named-competitor comparison, or make it like-for-like, cite the source (e.g. FOPH premium data) and reference year, and align it with Sympany's comparative advertising policy.

rules.title: Intermediary recruitment quoting commission income
rules.description: Broker or intermediary recruitment content quoting commission or income levels without the industry-agreement commission caps and variable-earnings context

detection.signal: Job-ad layout with a salary, commission or income range plus broker / intermediary keywords

rules.basis: KVG/LAMal Art. 4a binding industry agreement on intermediaries (santésuisse / curafutura Branchenvereinbarung) — commission caps. Needs Sympany intermediary recruitment policy
rules.reviewerNote: Recruitment posts quoting commission income can mislead on the capped, variable nature of intermediary earnings under the binding industry agreement. Requires Sympany's intermediary recruitment policy before it can be enforced.
rules.suggestedFix: State that intermediary earnings are variable and capped under the industry agreement, and include the FINMA registration and training requirements, per the recruitment policy.

rules.title: Award or rating claim without year and issuer
rules.description: Award, rating or test-winner claim (e.g. customer satisfaction survey, comparison portal rating) without qualifying year and issuing body

detection.signal: Award / rating keyword without a four-digit year and an issuer in the same frame

rules.basis: UWG/LCD Art. 3 para. 1 lit. b; SLK (Swiss Commission for Fairness) principles; Sympany brand policy
rules.reviewerNote: A rating or award claim without its qualifying year and issuing body can overstate current standing. A housekeeping defect rather than a consumer harm.
rules.suggestedFix: Add the qualifying year and the issuing body to the claim (e.g. "Customer satisfaction 2025, Comparis survey").

rules.title: Unapproved overlay or edit on approved creative
rules.description: Unapproved overlay, edit or personal opinion added to Sympany-approved creative
rules.dependency: Sympany brand governance. Needs creative library and template hash registry

detection.signal: Template hash mismatch; text overlay outside approved zones

rules.basis: Sympany brand governance. Needs creative library and template hash registry
rules.reviewerNote: Overlays or edits added to an approved Sympany creative can undo the approval. Requires the creative library and template hash registry to detect.
rules.suggestedFix: Revert to the approved creative. Route any overlay or edit through the Sympany approval workflow.

rules.title: Off-brand logo, identity or hashtag
rules.description: Off-brand Sympany logo treatment, unapproved visual identity or unapproved hashtag
rules.dependency: Sympany brand governance. Needs brand asset pack and hashtag allowlist

detection.signal: Logo integrity check; hashtag allowlist match

rules.basis: Sympany brand governance. Needs brand asset pack and hashtag allowlist
rules.reviewerNote: Off-brand logo treatment or an unapproved hashtag is a brand governance defect. Requires the Sympany brand asset pack and hashtag allowlist to detect.
rules.suggestedFix: Use the approved Sympany logo treatment and only hashtags on the brand allowlist.

rules.title: Key limitation stated where a product is named
rules.description: Where a product is named, its key limitation appears in the same asset (e.g. supplementary insurance is subject to a health declaration; model restrictions apply)
rules.dependency: UWG/LCD Art. 3; VVG/LCA Art. 3 pre-contractual information. Needs approved limitation phrase list

detection.signal: Product entity detected and no approved limitation phrase found in frame text, caption or transcript of the same asset

rules.basis: UWG/LCD Art. 3; VVG/LCA Art. 3. Needs approved phrase list
rules.reviewerNote: Where a product is named, its key limitation must appear in the same asset — for supplementary insurance that acceptance depends on a health declaration, for alternative models that the chosen first point of contact must be used. The check runs against Sympany's approved wording.
rules.suggestedFix: Add an approved limitation statement (e.g. "Supplementary insurance is subject to a health declaration") to the same asset as the product.

rules.title: Advisor identification and intermediary status stated
rules.description: Where a product is named, the poster is identified as a Sympany employee or a FINMA-registered insurance intermediary, with tied / untied status stated
rules.dependency: ISA/VAG Art. 45. Needs approved intermediary statement phrase list

detection.signal: Product entity detected and no advisor identification or intermediary status statement in the same asset

rules.basis: ISA/VAG Art. 45 (intermediary information duties); FINMA register of insurance intermediaries
rules.reviewerNote: Where a product is named, the poster must be identified as a Sympany employee or registered intermediary and state whether they are tied or untied. The check runs against Sympany's approved intermediary wording.
rules.suggestedFix: Add the advisor's identification and tied / untied intermediary status, using approved wording, to the same asset.

rules.title: Premium history or comparison is sourced and dated
rules.description: Where premium history, average premiums or premium development figures appear, the source and reference year appear in the same asset
rules.dependency: UWG/LCD Art. 3 para. 1 lit. b. Needs approved source & reference-date wording

detection.signal: Premium history or comparison content detected and no approved source / reference-date phrase in the same asset

rules.basis: UWG/LCD Art. 3 para. 1 lit. b. Needs approved source wording
rules.reviewerNote: Where premium history, averages or year-on-year premium development appear, the source (e.g. FOPH premium data) and the reference year must appear in the same asset, and past premium development must not be presented as a promise for future years.
rules.suggestedFix: Add the approved source and reference-date note (e.g. "Source: FOPH premium data 2026; future premiums may differ") to the same asset.

rules.title: Content dated and version-tagged for the register
rules.description: Content is dated and version-tagged for the Sympany digital advertising register

detection.signal: Metadata completeness check at submission

rules.basis: Sympany marketing governance; FINMA supervisory expectations on record-keeping
rules.reviewerNote: The digital advertising register requires each asset to be dated and version-tagged so it can be traced. A traceability defect, not a consumer harm.
rules.suggestedFix: Add a submission date and version tag to the asset metadata before publishing.

rules.title: General-information notice on educational content
rules.description: A general-information notice ("this is general information; cover is governed by the policy terms") is present on educational content

detection.signal: Content classified as educational with no general-information notice. Advisory because the classification is itself a judgement

rules.basis: UWG/LCD Art. 3; VVG/LCA Art. 3
rules.reviewerNote: Educational content (e.g. how deductibles or the Telmed model work) should carry a general-information notice. Whether content is educational is itself a judgement, so the engine flags but does not block.
rules.suggestedFix: Add a notice such as "This is general information. Your cover is governed by the policy terms and conditions (GTC/AVB)."

rules.title: Paid or incentivised content is labelled
rules.description: Paid, sponsored or incentivised content (influencer, referral or broker promotion) is clearly labelled

detection.signal: Referral code, promo link or affiliate tag present without a disclosure label

rules.basis: UWG/LCD Art. 2 & 3 (hidden advertising); SLK principles on recognisability of commercial communication. Less relevant where content carries Sympany branding
rules.reviewerNote: Paid, sponsored or incentivised content must be recognisable as advertising. Less relevant where the content already carries Sympany branding, so it is advisory.
rules.suggestedFix: Add a clear paid, sponsored or incentivised disclosure label (e.g. #ad / #Werbung) alongside any referral code, promo link or affiliate tag.

rules.title: Disclosures in frame and not truncated
rules.description: Disclosures are in frame, not truncated and not placed behind a link
rules.dependency: UWG/LCD Art. 3. Needs Sympany legibility thresholds

detection.signal: Disclosure text located; bounding box height ratio and contrast ratio against threshold

rules.basis: UWG/LCD Art. 3. Needs Sympany legibility thresholds
rules.reviewerNote: Disclosures must be in frame, legible and not hidden behind a link. Requires Sympany's legibility thresholds (height and contrast) before it can be enforced.
rules.suggestedFix: Place disclosures in frame at the required size and contrast, not behind a link.

rules.title: Video disclosures persist long enough to read
rules.description: Video disclosures remain on screen long enough to be read
rules.dependency: UWG/LCD Art. 3. Needs Sympany minimum duration

detection.signal: Frame-persistence count for the disclosure region against a minimum duration

rules.basis: UWG/LCD Art. 3. Needs Sympany minimum duration
rules.reviewerNote: A video disclosure must remain on screen long enough to be read. Requires Sympany's minimum on-screen duration before it can be enforced.
rules.suggestedFix: Keep the disclosure on screen for at least the required minimum duration.

rules.title: Product name matches approved register
rules.description: Product or insurance model name matches the Sympany approved-product register (KVG models and VVG products) exactly

detection.signal: Fuzzy match against product master; flags near-misses and retired product names

rules.basis: Needs Sympany approved-product register feed
rules.reviewerNote: Product and insurance model names must match the approved-product register exactly, to catch near-misses and retired names. Requires the approved-product register feed.
rules.suggestedFix: Use the exact approved product or model name from the current Sympany product register.

rules.title: Copy aligns with approved copy library
rules.description: Copy aligns with the approved Sympany copy library for that product
rules.dependency: Needs Sympany approved copy library feed

detection.signal: Similarity score against the approved copy corpus below threshold

rules.basis: Needs Sympany approved copy library feed
rules.reviewerNote: Copy should align with the approved copy library for the product. Requires the approved copy library feed.
rules.suggestedFix: Bring the copy back in line with the approved copy library for that product.

rules.title: Approved template or asset ID traceable
rules.description: The approved template or creative asset ID is traceable
rules.dependency: Sympany marketing governance. Needs creative library

detection.signal: Watermark or asset-ID lookup against the creative library

rules.basis: Sympany marketing governance. Needs creative library
rules.reviewerNote: The approved template or creative asset ID must be traceable. Requires the creative library to look up.
rules.suggestedFix: Use an approved template with a traceable asset ID or watermark.

rules.title: Lead route points to an official channel
rules.description: Lead or contact route points to an official Sympany channel (sympany.ch, mySympany, official social handles) — no cold-calling or third-party lead lists
rules.dependency: Industry agreement on intermediaries (no cold calling). Needs maintained allowlist

detection.signal: URL and social handle allowlist check

rules.basis: KVG/LAMal Art. 4a binding industry agreement on intermediaries (santésuisse / curafutura Branchenvereinbarung — ban on cold calling). Needs maintained allowlist
rules.reviewerNote: Lead and contact routes must point to an official Sympany channel; the binding industry agreement bans cold calling and the use of purchased lead lists. Requires a maintained URL and handle allowlist.
rules.suggestedFix: Point the lead or contact route to an official Sympany channel on the allowlist (e.g. sympany.ch or the mySympany app).

rules.title: Basic insurance advertised with gifts or bundling
rules.description: Basic insurance (KVG/LAMal) advertised with a gift, cash bonus or inducement, or made conditional on taking out supplementary insurance

detection.signal: Lexicon match on inducement or bundling wording: switching bonus, welcome gift, cash bonus, gift card, only together with supplementary insurance

rules.basis: KVG/LAMal Art. 4 & 7 (free choice of insurer, acceptance obligation); binding industry agreement on intermediaries (Branchenvereinbarung); FINMA supervision of supplementary insurance (VVG/LCA)
rules.reviewerNote: Every person must be accepted for basic insurance without conditions. Inducements to switch basic insurance, or making it conditional on supplementary insurance, breach the KVG and the industry agreement.
rules.suggestedFix: Remove the gift, bonus or bundling condition. Basic and supplementary insurance must be offered and concluded independently of each other.
